'''Shinnan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Another Hopetown]] on [[Ennth]], who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Rastur]]. She had sepia eyes and dark brown hair. She was a friend of [[Zekk]] and died during the evacuation process when a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] struck. At the time of her [[Death/Legends|death]], she was trying to locate the plans for the new house she and her husband were going to build after the quakes had stopped. The groundquake was part of a series of groundquakes that take place every eight years on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Ennth.
